note: v496: The app now goes by your actual local date. It was reading the day in UTC, so after about 6pm everything shifted to tomorrow — an invoice due today showed as overdue, tonight's job showed as a missed event, the calendar ringed the wrong day and the Today button jumped ahead, and an expense logged after supper saved with tomorrow's date. On New Year's Eve it moved the year. Home is also lighter: the folded cards (cash flow, spend grid, spending by category, Upcoming) are only built when you open them, the calendar refreshes when something on it changes, and dragging across the cash-flow chart scrolls the page again instead of sticking.
